name: Sergeant Kara Briggs
personality: Disciplined, frustrated, stuck between orders and reality.
description: Sergeant Briggs commands the Frontier Compact detachment near Primm. She’s under strict orders not to intervene unless absolutely necessary.
questHooks: Needs intel on Powder Ganger movements.
Worries about strange radio interference near Primm.
Says Frontier Compact scouts reported a faint hum coming from the rollercoaster.
